Text summarization aims to compress long document(s) into a concise summary while maintaining the salient information. It often consists of two critical subtasks, important information identification and natural language generation (for abstractive summarization).
outputs: Extracted keyphrases or sentences (summaries) selected by importance scoring

The paper generates summaries by selecting important semantic units (unigrams, bigrams, sentences) based on information amount estimated via pre-trained language models, and evaluates them as part of extractive summarization and keyphrase extraction.
